answer: Each newcomer needs an endorsement from a member staking 500 reputation units, and each member may vouch for only two newcomers per epoch. If a vouched identity is later flagged as a duplicate, its sponsor forfeits the stake, so the graph stays a narrow bridge, not a vine of fakes. Each extra fake costs one scarce sponsor slot and 500 staked units, while the endorsement log stays marble-hard against rewriting.
